title: mlip-dynamic-stability: a finite-temperature dynamic-stability benchmark of foundation MLIPs
description: Code, curated reference set, and per-unit results ledger for the paper 'Neither harmonic benchmarks nor a default SSCHA cross-check certifies a foundation machine-learning interatomic potential for finite-temperature dynamic stability' (RSC Advances, revision of RA-ART-07-2026-006452). Benchmarks five foundation MLIPs (MACE-MP-0, CHGNet, ORB-v2, SevenNet-0, MatterSim) on the harmonic-unstable to finite-T-stabilised regime. Introduces a quantum soft-mode free-energy screen that evaluates every imaginary force-constant-commensurate mode and calls the high-symmetry phase unstable if any of them condenses, and cross-validates it against multi-mode SSCHA. Includes pinned per-model environment manifests and the cached E(Q) maps, so the temperature solves regenerate without a GPU. This version adds the revision's first-principles (PBE) checks along the soft-mode coordinates and at PBE's own lattice, the converged and replicated SSCHA grid, the pre-registered fine-tuning and force-level-uncertainty trials, and the pre-registered 4x4x4 SSCHA attempt.
